data.section: Allianz purchase: add-ons, Confirmation, switching insurer
data.situation: Allianz add-ons and Confirmation with e-Invoice details: pick Tokio Marine first, go back to Allianz; tick / untick add-ons; Confirmation with TIN; pay; same add-ons on receipt and CIBO
data.setup:
• When: after Dev deploys EAINT-12406 to the Secarang staging and CIBO staging (which staging: Q1)
• Secarang customer site on staging (Q1), opened as a member of the public (no login), desktop browser
• CIBO on staging: the QA team's CIBO login (Q2). Open each CIBO page read-only once first and use its real filter / column names
• Car owner: a test identity the insurers quote on staging (Q3, Q12). Never the QA's own name, IC, phone or address
• Owner e-Invoice details: a test TIN (Tax Identification Number) for the test identity
• Vehicle: an individual-owner renewal car that all three insurers quote (not used by another row)
• Payment: Fiuu sandbox, Online Banking (FPX) > RHB (an FPX RHB payment settled on Secarang staging on 20.10.2026, EAINT-12566)
• For comparison: the Confirmation pages of the Lonpac (12406_QT_TS4) and Tokio Marine (QT_TS3) purchases
data.steps:
1. Secarang: the car + owner > Choose your insurance > select Tokio Marine > on Add-ons go back > select Allianz
2. Add-ons: screenshot every add-on offered with its price (recorded against the SA brief list: all-driver, CART, Road Rangers, PAB-ERW, MPA A/B, agreed value; Q32); tick two add-ons and note the premium; untick one and note the premium
3. Confirmation: fill the owner details including the e-Invoice fields (TIN); screenshot which fields carry "*" and its colour, the agent line and commission % (recorded, compared with the Lonpac / Tokio Marine Confirmation; Q37); Confirm and Pay
4. FPX > RHB approve; screenshot the Payment successful page; download the Receipt
5. CIBO > Transaction Details: screenshot the Car Owner Details (TIN) and the premium breakdown with Add-ons
data.expected:
Ensure:
• After going back from Tokio Marine and selecting Allianz, the Add-ons and Confirmation pages are for Allianz (no Tokio Marine name or price)
• Ticking an add-on adds its shown price to the premium; unticking it takes the price off again
• The add-on left ticked and its amount are the same on Confirmation, on the Secarang receipt (Add-ons) and on CIBO Transaction Details (Add-ons)
• The purchase with the e-Invoice details (TIN) filled completes: Payment successful page with a Receipt; CIBO Transaction Details shows the same TIN
• Receipt and CIBO show Allianz as the insurer (no Tokio Marine)

points.text: After going back from Tokio Marine and selecting Allianz, the Add-ons and Confirmation pages are for Allianz (no Tokio Marine name or price)

Receipt and CIBO show Allianz as the insurer (no Tokio Marine)
